pkgmetadata.longdescription:
OpenD is the gateway daemon of the moomoo (Futu) OpenAPI. It is not the trading GUI: it relays protocol requests between a local SDK (moomoo-api for Python, Java, C#, C++, JavaScript) and moomoo's servers. The SDK connects to it on localhost:11111.
Upstream ships Ubuntu 18.04 and CentOS 7 builds. The bundled shared libraries are found through a RUNPATH beginning with $ORIGIN, so the tree is relocatable and needs no patchelf treatment.

use.flag: Install the command-line OpenD (the one used for API access)
Install the Qt GUI variant as well
